overview: Orlando is the theme park capital of the world: Walt Disney World's four parks, Universal Orlando with the Wizarding World of Harry Potter, plus Kennedy Space Center and Florida's beaches.
fit: The ultimate kids' trip. Best when the younger one is a bit taller for more rides, but Magic Kingdom is perfect at 4.
season: November–April is mild (15–28°C). Summer is hot, humid and stormy; June–November is hurricane season. Avoid US holiday weeks (Christmas, Thanksgiving, spring break in March).

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Orlando (1–2 stops via Dubai/Doha/Europe and a US hub)

gettingAround: Hire a car (or Disney/Universal resort buses if staying on site).

todo.title: Magic Kingdom
todo.book: Multi-day tickets are cheaper per day; buy Lightning Lane for top rides

Kennedy Space Center
todo.why: Rockets and the Space Shuttle Atlantis

stay.area: Disney Springs area / Lake Buena Vista

foodTips: Vegetarian is easy in the parks.
save: Buy multi-day park tickets in advance
Travel in late January–February or early November
safety: Heat and long queues; pace yourselves
Use height charts to set expectations
health: Travel health insurance is essential (US healthcare is very expensive)
kids: Plan rest afternoons at the hotel pool
Use the Disney app for queue times
visa: US B-2 tourist visa for all four, with an interview for adults at the US consulate in Chennai (children under 14 usually don't need to attend). Fee about US$185 per person. Interview wait times can be many months, so apply as early as possible.
